task.description: Idiom/scope gate on ELIXIR-DEV's application of REQ-237's .zig provenance-marking convention to chunk 238b2 (9 engine/*.ex files), branch feature/WF02-REQ246-20260905, commit 469af4a4, off main@17ac5934.

result.summary: Independently re-verified all claims by direct grep/diff against main and the feature branch (not the handoff paraphrase). Before-count: per-file .zig line counts sum to 32 (3+1+2+4+3+1+3+3+12), 0 pre-existing PROVENANCE markers on main -- confirmed. After: same per-file .zig counts (unchanged, no citation text lost), 25 total markers -- confirmed by direct grep -c sums. Divergence-line grep ('unlike R-Co|deliberately diverges|diverges from R-Co') returns zero matches on both main and the feature branch across all 9 files -- genuinely empty both before and after, not vacuously 'unmodified'. Full diff (git diff main...feature/WF02-REQ246-20260905 -- lib/) shows every added line is exactly the literal marker text -- confirmed programmatically that no non-marker line was added or removed; no file outside the 9 in-scope files (plus handoffs/) touched. Per-line scan confirms zero unmarked .zig citations remain in any of the 9 files (every .zig line has a PROVENANCE marker within its blank-line-bounded unit). List-item placement verified directly: variable_schema.ex has 5 list-item markers (tasks.form_schema bullet, REQ-078 bullet, REQ-082 bullet, numbered item 3, 'not a map' bullet) each on its own standalone line above the item, not merged into the item's text; variable_merge.ex has 1, same pattern. Minor immaterial discrepancy: ELIXIR-DEV's self-report said 'variable_schema.ex x6' list items but the actual diff shows 5 (4 of the 9 markers there are paragraph-unit, not list-item) -- a miscount in the narrative only, not a defect in the applied code; every marker is correctly placed regardless of category. task.ex's heading-vs-paragraph split (heading '## Scope' marked as its own single-line unit, separate from the following paragraph's marker) is a correct application of section 2's single-citation-line rule. The two '# '-prefixed markers (reconstruction.ex line 447 content 'REQ-054's own new lookup...' preceded by '# PROVENANCE...', sub_process.ex line ~811 'OQ-2 (req062...)' preceded by '# PROVENANCE...') are correctly placed immediately above the Elixir-comment block they annotate, consistent with the '#'-comment precedent. Idiom/supervision/type-safety: not applicable -- this is a pure moduledoc/doc-comment text-insertion change, no code logic, no @spec, no process/supervision structure touched. No scope creep: change is confined exactly to the 9 files this requirement's chunk lists; no abstraction, behaviour, or new plumbing introduced. TEST-DESIGNER routing: SKIP is correct -- there is no executable behavior change to cover; ORCH/TEST-RUNNER's ORCH-verified mix compile/format/test results (clean, 244 passed) are sufficient and this gate does not require additional test-suite involvement.
